question.worked_solution:
We see from the graph that as $x$ approaches $6$ from the left, the function $f(x)$ approaches $\infty .$ So, the left-hand limit is

$$
{lim}_{x\to {6}^{-}}f(x)=\infty \,.
$$

Likewise, as $x$ approaches $6$ from the right, the function $f(x)$ again approaches $\infty .$ So, the right-hand limit is

$$
{lim}_{x\to {6}^{+}}f(x)=\infty \,.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{lim}_{x\to 6}f(x)=\infty \,.
$$
